Home.seo_title: MEARROW — K-pop Company Fan Voting & Rankings
Home.seo_intro: MEARROW is an independent, fan-made K-pop Talent Network. It records daily fan votes for entertainment companies, publishes a live ranking for the current monthly season, and keeps a public archive of champions.
Home.seo_how_desc: MEARROW operates on a unique league system inspired by European football. Companies compete in two divisions: the Premier League (1st Division) featuring top-performing companies, and the Challengers League (2nd Division) where rising companies battle for promotion. At the end of each monthly season, the bottom-ranked Premier League companies are relegated to Challengers, while the top Challengers earn their spot in the Premier League. This creates thrilling competition and gives every company a chance to reach the top.
Home.seo_vote_desc: Every fan receives daily votes that refresh at midnight (KST). No registration or login is required — simply visit MEARROW and cast your votes for the company you want to support. Your vote counts equally toward the real-time rankings, and you can track your impact as the numbers update instantly.
Home.seo_season_desc: MEARROW runs on a monthly season cycle. Each month brings a fresh start with reset rankings, giving every company an equal opportunity to compete. At the end of the season, the top-ranked company in the Premier League is crowned the monthly champion and inducted into the Hall of Fame.
Home.seo_global_title: A Global Platform for K-pop Fans
Home.seo_global_desc: MEARROW is currently available in 7 languages: Korean, English, Japanese, Chinese, Spanish, French, and German.
Home.seo_data_desc: Ranking totals represent votes recorded on MEARROW during the current monthly season. They are a fan signal, not an official industry chart. Previous champions remain available in the Hall of Fame.
Home.seo_trust_desc: MEARROW is an unofficial fan-made service and is not affiliated with entertainment companies. News articles identify their sources and distinguish reported facts from MEARROW commentary.

HallOfFame.seo_title: MEARROW Hall of Fame — Celebrating K-pop Company Champions
HallOfFame.seo_subtitle: MEARROW's official archive preserves the monthly champions and annual Grand Champions created by fan votes.
HallOfFame.seo_how_desc: At the end of each monthly season, the company at No. 1 in the Premier League is recorded as that month's champion. The annual Grand Champion is the company with the most monthly wins that year.
HallOfFame.seo_history_desc: Browse through the complete history of MEARROW champions, from the very first season to the present day. See which companies have dominated, which have made surprise appearances at the top, and how the competitive landscape has evolved over time. Each champion's record includes their total vote count, winning margin, and the season during which they earned their title.
HallOfFame.seo_legacy_desc: Every vote in the current season helps decide the next monthly champion. Support your favorite company and help create the archive's next chapter.
HallOfFame.seo_system_desc: MEARROW's championship system operates on a monthly cycle. Each season begins on the first day of the month, and every company starts with zero votes. Throughout the month, fans from around the world cast their votes to push their favorite companies up the rankings. On the final day, the company at the top of the Premier League is permanently enshrined in the Hall of Fame. Grand Champions are determined by total monthly victories across all seasons — a true measure of sustained fandom dedication.

Editorial.meta_description: Learn how MEARROW researches, explains, and updates its public information.
Editorial.title: Editorial standards
Editorial.subtitle: How we research, explain, and update public information.
Editorial.intro: MEARROW is an independent, fan-made K-pop platform. This page explains how we present voting data and the news archive on the public site.
Editorial.sources_body: When source material is available, reported claims can be linked to an official notice, chart, organizer, or reputable news outlet. Articles show those links when available so readers can check the original context.
Editorial.analysis_body: A news article aims to add clear MEARROW context instead of repeating a headline. Source links and analysis are included when available, and readers can contact us when a detail needs review.
Editorial.ranking_body: Ranking totals are votes recorded on MEARROW during the current monthly season. They represent fan activity on this service and are not an official industry chart or an endorsement by an entertainment company.
Editorial.updates_body: We show when an article was published and update it when an important detail changes. Time-sensitive audition information should always be checked against the organizer's official page before applying.
Editorial.corrections_body: When we find a factual error or an outdated detail, we review the source, update the article, and keep the explanation clear for readers. Please contact us if something needs checking.
Editorial.contact_body: Questions, source suggestions, and correction requests are welcome by email.

FAQ.meta_description: Find answers to frequently asked questions about MEARROW. Learn about voting, league system, rankings, privacy, and more.
FAQ.title: Frequently Asked Questions
FAQ.subtitle: Find answers to common questions about MEARROW
FAQ.a1: MEARROW (K-pop Talent Network) is a global fan engagement platform where K-pop fans worldwide vote for their favorite entertainment companies to create real-time rankings. It is an unofficial fan-made service not affiliated with any entertainment company.
FAQ.a2: Simply click the 'Vote' button next to your favorite company on the main page. Votes are refreshed daily at midnight, and anyone can participate without registration.
FAQ.a3: Votes are automatically refreshed at midnight (KST). The number of daily votes is limited to ensure fair competition.
FAQ.q4: How does the league system work?
FAQ.a4: MEARROW consists of a Premier League (1st Division) and Challengers (2nd Division). At the end of each monthly season, bottom-ranked Premier League teams are relegated while top Challengers are promoted. This creates dynamic competition.
FAQ.a5: Rankings are based on the total votes each company receives during the current season (month). They update in real-time, and all votes carry equal weight.
FAQ.a6: MEARROW collects minimal information. We don't store actual IP addresses — only anonymized hashes. No registration is required, so we don't collect emails or passwords. See our Privacy Policy for details.
FAQ.a7: No. MEARROW is an unofficial fan-made service created by K-pop enthusiasts. It has no official affiliation or sponsorship with any entertainment company.
FAQ.q8: How can I report a bug or make a suggestion?
FAQ.a8: Please email us at contact@kcl.fan. Your feedback helps us improve MEARROW for everyone.
FAQ.a9: MEARROW currently supports 7 languages: Korean, English, Japanese, Chinese, Spanish, French, and German.

Notice.title: Notices
Notice.subtitle: Stay updated with the latest news from MEARROW
Notice.seo_intro: Stay informed with the latest announcements, updates, and events from MEARROW. Our notices section keeps you up to date on platform changes, new features, upcoming events, and important policy updates. Whether it's a new season launch, a special voting event, or a system maintenance notice, you'll find all the important information here.
Notice.seo_categories_desc: Browse notices by category to find what matters to you. Official notices cover platform policies and important announcements. Update notices inform you about new features and improvements to MEARROW. Event notices highlight special activities, competitions, and fan engagement opportunities that you won't want to miss.
Notice.seo_stay_desc: MEARROW is constantly evolving to provide the best experience for K-pop fans worldwide. Check back regularly for the latest updates, or follow our announcements to never miss an important notice. Your feedback and participation help shape the future of MEARROW.
Notice.seo_why_desc: Staying informed about MEARROW updates ensures you never miss important changes that could affect your voting strategy. Season transitions, rule changes, special events, and new feature launches are all announced here first. By following our notices, you gain an edge in understanding when new seasons begin, how the promotion and relegation system evolves, and what exciting opportunities lie ahead for K-pop fans worldwide.
